description: Introspective: how we know, grow, understand ourselves. Not moral judgment (that's ETH) and not action/success-oriented (that's PER).
Right/wrong, character, integrity -- normatively loaded. Domain-specific ethics (business, political) still tags here as primary.
Concrete social structures/groups -- gender, caste, media's social role, education access. Closest bucket to old-style GS1 Society content.
State machinery, federalism, democracy's mechanics. Almost entirely pre-2019 -- post-2018 essays stopped asking about institutions directly.
Growth models, inequality, capitalism vs welfare -- the economic-philosophy angle, not policy mechanics.
Tech's effect on society/knowledge, not tech mechanics.
Ecology, forests, human-nature relationship at civilizational scale. Small bucket historically.
India-specific civilizational/national character, not generic patriotism. Small bucket.
Action-oriented life-quotes: courage, resilience, decision-making, success. Largest bucket post-2018.
Global order, war/peace, India's world role. Small, at most one per year.
Pure aphorisms resisting any domain -- ambiguity, time, contentment, epistemology with no clear subject-matter hook.
Reserved -- mental health, wellbeing, healthcare-as-lived-experience (distinct from SOC's structural healthcare-access angle). Promote to active on first clear PYQ hit.
Reserved -- climate action/lifestyle-choice angle distinct from ENV's civilizational nature-relationship framing. Promote on first clear PYQ hit.
Reserved -- split candidate from SCI if UPSC keeps returning to AI/automation specifically rather than tech-in-society generally.
Reserved -- split candidate from GOV if federalism-specific essays recur; currently folded into GOV.
